QuestInfo.name: [FriendStory] SCRS and PSTL 3
QuestInfo.0: The PSTL have a response to the SCRS's condemnation. Talk to the PSTL members.
QuestInfo.1: The PSTL members claim that they are infatuated with the Pale Student Teacher and will not let anyone get in their way. Return to Stan to tell him what's going on.
QuestInfo.2: Stan's scolding seems to have quieted down the ruckus between the SCRS and PSTL. For now.
